test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six persons, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting around a circular table. All are facing the centre of the table. Only two persons are sitting between D and A. F is to the immediate right of C. E is second to the right of F. E is second to the left of A. Who is sitting to the immediate right of F?
solution:
Given, Six persons, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting around a circular table. All are facing the centre of the table.

Only two persons are sitting between D and A.

E is second to the left of A.

E is second to the right of F.

F is to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/817ad04747ef24b25d7a53353d6258d14e10de1cf222e158520b1d57a8a3a732.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b882b058a8eec8c0cdea588e806beec5a3d1bf32f96a94f49fef3da628880966.png] 

And B sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72e4cba1ab6bc5e74dc10cfc4c378a39345be959ec733947409dbf8d8d524ae.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cca43232e0f541bc5a81391f0990bf8856cfc2564802ad133a546dd87d525af3.png] 

D is sitting to the immediate right of F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
